title: 第一卷 第6115章 镇杀天之道衣第一卷 第6114章 葬神之地的净土
content_zh:
这是怎样的一指？
于无数试炼者的眼中，轻飘无力，随意至极。
仿佛只是做出一个凌空按压的动作。
可是……
站在这颗星辰之上的裂空少主，神情陡然大变。
在他的视线尽头，那一指掀起了无尽的狂浪，扰乱了日月星天，如诸天之巅降临的天之神柱，凌空碾压下来，仿佛可以压塌万古。
怎样的神术，都不能比肩这样的一指，万千道与法的变化，在这一指面前都失去了意义。
那是极致的力量，亦是无穷的劫数。
砰！
虚空砰然爆开，整颗星辰的世界屏障，宛如镜面一般裂开，荡起一道毁灭的天地同心圆。
破！
破！
破！
一切有形、无形的气机与力量，全部都在此刻破碎掉。
站在此间的裂空少主，身躯震颤，心灵抖动，神魂恐惧，仿佛在那可怕的一指镇压中，失去了自我，忘记了抵抗。
但这尊属于第八层诸天大势力的旷世妖孽，终究非同常人。
在那一指即将抵达的刹那……
裂空少主仰天大吼：“天之道衣！”
嗡！
以他为中心，四周的天地时空产生了紊乱，无数的法则与规则，顷刻间疯狂运转起来，和裂空少主产生了共鸣。

层层空间壁垒，顿时诞生出来，要抵挡叶寒的这一指。
而同时，他的身躯表面则是覆盖了一件无上的战袍……
天之道衣。
轰！
顷刻间，层层空间壁垒全部破碎。
那无与伦比的一指，携带着无穷变化的劫气，硬生生轰杀在了天之道衣之上。
这一刹，时间仿佛陷入了静止，停止了流逝。
天地万物，所有的一切，都定格在了这一幕之中。
在诸多试炼者的视线、神念尽头，叶寒站在星空之上，保持着那一指杀出的姿势，一动不动。
在那颗星辰上，站在那里的裂空少主，同样一动不动。
可是很快……
所有试炼者，就看到了最为惊悚的画面。
那裂空少主的身躯、面容、脑袋，可谓是浑身上下，只要显现在外的地方，全部都已被鲜血所浸染，或是正有大量的鲜血在不断从口鼻耳目之间渗出。
破碎，所有的一切法则、规则、护身罡甲、贴身战甲，全部破碎。
包括五脏六腑，乃至气海，都在这一瞬间四分五裂。
甚至于，裂空少主的魂海，都在一瞬间被撕裂开来，无数的劫气冲入了其中，对他的神魂展开冲击。
唯有神国，勉强能够坚持。
content_en:
What kind of finger is this?
In the eyes of countless testers, he is light and powerless, and extremely casual.
It seemed like he was just making a volley and pressing action.
But...
The expression of Young Master Splitting Kong, who was standing above the star, suddenly changed.
At the end of his sight, that finger set off endless wild waves, disrupting the sun, moon, and stars. It was like a divine pillar descending from the top of the heavens, crushing it down in the air, as if it could collapse eternity.
No amount of magic can compare to such a finger. Thousands of changes in Tao and Dharma lose their meaning in front of this finger.
That is the ultimate power, and it is also an infinite disaster.
Bang!
The void suddenly exploded, and the world barrier of the entire star cracked like a mirror, creating a concentric circle of destruction.
break!
break!
break!
All visible and invisible qi and power were shattered at this moment.
Standing here, Young Master Splitting Kong's body trembled, his mind trembled, and his soul was frightened, as if he had lost himself and forgotten to resist under that terrible finger of suppression.
But this unparalleled monster, who belongs to the great forces of the eighth level, is no ordinary human being after all.
At the moment when the finger is about to arrive...
Young Master Likong looked up to the sky and shouted: "The Taoist Clothes of Heaven!"
Buzz!
With him as the center, the surrounding heaven, earth, time and space became chaotic, and countless laws and regulations began to run wildly in an instant, resonating with the young master of the sky.
Layers of space barriers were suddenly born to resist Ye Han's finger.
At the same time, the surface of his body was covered with a supreme battle robe...
Heaven's Taoist Clothes.
boom!
In an instant, all the layers of space barriers were shattered.
That incomparable finger, carrying the infinitely changing calamity energy, struck directly at the Dao Yi of Heaven.
At this moment, time seemed to stand still and stopped passing.
Everything in the world is frozen in this scene.
At the end of the sights and spiritual thoughts of many trialists, Ye Han stood above the starry sky, maintaining the posture of killing with one finger, motionless.
On that star, Young Master Likong stood there, also motionless.
But soon...
All the trialists saw the most horrifying scene.
The body, face, and head of Young Master Splitting Kong were all soaked in blood, as long as they appeared outside, or there was a large amount of blood seeping out from between the mouth, nose, ears, and eyes.
Broken, all the laws, rules, protective armor, and personal armor were all shattered.
Including the five internal organs, and even the sea of ​​qi, all fell apart at this moment.
Even the soul sea of ​​Young Master Split Kong was torn open in an instant, and countless calamity energies rushed into it, attacking his soul.
Only the Kingdom of God can barely hold on.
